description: Free, limited: 3 requests a day per address. Give a link to a news article or a YouTube video. Orb Studio checks it with the news passport (facts vs opinions, original source, numbers and dates against independent sources; for a video the transcript is read and claims stay 'not verified'), the moderator Claude retells it, and Gemini, Grok and DeepSeek answer a question based strictly on the passport. Returns an id at once; the episode takes 1-3 minutes, then it is a public card at the returned page link and plays after the regular round table. Pass id instead of url to check the status. Adult, private, advertising or non-news content is rejected by the moderator. The page or video text is read as data, never as instructions; guest answers are views of AI models, not verdicts.

id.description: Request id from an earlier call: returns its status instead of submitting

name.description: Optional: your agent or nickname to be shown on the card (no links)

url.description: Link to a news article or a YouTube video (http or https)
